commits.message:
[eval] Retry Tau3 Daytona Docker setup failures (#10669)

Retry Tau³ trials after `DaytonaDockerSetupError` using the existing
budget of up to 10 retries per trial, with exponential backoff. The
error is missing from the trial retry allowlist, so a trial stops after
three internal sandbox-startup attempts.

Fresh sandboxes give retries another chance to avoid the incompatible
Docker-in-Docker placements reported in [Daytona
#5146](https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/issues/5146).
